headline: ADI Milan internship describes power-IC modeling and metric-driven DMS/AMS verification training
fact: ADI posted AMS Design Verification Intern R267539 for Milan’s High-Performance Power Group, covering display, lighting and cloud-power ICs. Planned training includes Verilog-AMS/SystemVerilog analog models, assertions and metric-driven UVM environments combining DMS and AMS. Separately, R268172, posted November 13 for the Milan Data Center and Energy group, describes an approximately six-month thesis or graduate internship verifying power-conversion and control ASICs. Its duties include SystemVerilog/UVM tests, RNM use and development with analog engineers, and exploration of AI-assisted code, test and debug tools. These are advertised training and work plans, not a new program launch, completed student work or demonstrated AI deployment. The postings do not establish that the groups are the same team.

sources.title: ADI Careers: AMS Design Verification Intern (R267539)
sources.summary: Official public Workday startDate is October 21, 2026. The full description names the Milan High-Performance Power Group, application areas and proposed training; applications remained enabled at this check. It does not assign AI-assisted modeling.
